action.objective: Verify g2g3, the reserved broad-search suggestion, at depth 4 to obtain single-candidate safety and commit readiness.
action.rationale: Phase is verify_or_replan. Broad search completed at depth 3 with g2g3 exact 605 top, but commit_ready_moves is empty and no verification exists yet. The reserved verification reserve (2000 nodes) is specifically for g2g3. Key tactical concerns: Black queen on h4 and bishop on e6 eyes f2, and f8b4+ appears in the PV; g3 directly questions the queen and stops Qh3/Qg4 harassment, so it deserves a full depth-4 single-candidate check including the mate-in-one safety probe.
